law_name: Copyright Act 2002 (Act No. 12 of 2002), 2020 Revised Edition, Chapter 17.05
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years; anonymous and collective works 50 years from creation or publication; applied art 25 years from creation
moral_rights: Moral rights recognized (dedicated section in Part I; article number and duration not confirmed) (unconfirmed)
notes: Adopted 30 Jul 2002, assented 4 Mar 2004, in force 1 Sep 2008 (WIPO Lex). Berne 14 Jun 2001, WTO 27 Jul 2007 (Commons). Commons says government works are public domain.
